mintAuthority.summary: mTBILL has issuer-native deployments on Ethereum, Base, Rootstock, Plume, and Etherlink. October 1 pinned reads confirm the four listed deposit-vault minters on Ethereum, Base, Rootstock and Etherlink, and EOA 0x7ef55ff58dc56ef387bb73a3b63abe9fc47359dd on Rootstock and Etherlink. The listed Plume vault does not hold M_TBILL_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE at Plume block 96620582. Previously recorded Base/Rootstock EOA and Rootstock/Etherlink Safe mint grants are no longer active; the remaining EOA's Plume grant is also absent. Chain-local 1-of-3 admin Safes and the shared admin EOA retain immediate grant authority; chain-local timelocks retain a two-day delay. Role enumeration is unavailable through the queried ABI, so this is not an exhaustive holder census.

controls.label: mTBILL multichain deposit-vault minters
controls.capDescription: No on-chain supply cap was identified; the listed Ethereum, Base, Rootstock and Etherlink vaults hold M_TBILL_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE. The listed Plume vault does not hold that role at Plume block 96620582.
controls.evidence: October 1 pinned hasRole reads confirmed the listed Ethereum, Base, Rootstock and Etherlink deposit-vault proxies as M_TBILL_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE holders at blocks 26095802, 52024146, 9286812 and 54657576 respectively. The issuer-listed Plume vault 0xb05f6aa8c2ea9ab8537cf09a9b765a21de249224 did not hold that role at Plume block 96620582. These observations are not an exhaustive minter census.

controls.label: mTBILL Rootstock and Etherlink direct-minter EOA
controls.capDescription: No on-chain supply cap was identified; this EOA retains M_TBILL_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE on Rootstock and Etherlink, but not Plume.
controls.evidence: At Rootstock block 9286812 and Etherlink block 54657576, hasRole(M_TBILL_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE,0x7ef55ff58dc56ef387bb73a3b63abe9fc47359dd) returned true and eth_getCode returned 0x. At Plume block 96620582 the same role query returned false. Historical July 13 grants on all three chains are retained in the review history, but Plume is no longer a current deployment reference.

controls.label: Midas mTBILL multichain DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE Safes
controls.evidence: October 1 pinned reads at Ethereum 26095802, Base 52024146, Rootstock 9286812, Plume 96620582, and Etherlink 54657576 confirmed DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE for the listed chain-local Safes. Each getThreshold() returned 1 and getOwners() returned three owners; getModulesPaginated() returned no modules and the Safe guard slot was zero. Owner sets differ by chain. The role can change minter grants immediately.

controls.label: Midas mTBILL multichain DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA
controls.evidence: October 1 pinned hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE,0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227) returned true on all five MidasAccessControl deployments at Ethereum 26095802, Base 52024146, Rootstock 9286812, Plume 96620582, and Etherlink 54657576. eth_getCode returned 0x on every chain. This authority can immediately grant or revoke M_TBILL_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE independently on each chain.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, Base block 48598894, Rootstock block 9049318, Plume block 80928370, and Etherlink block 48212139, every listed token, access-control, and deposit-vault transparent proxy resolved through its chain-local ProxyAdmin. ProxyAdmin ownership resolved to timelocks 0xe3eee3e0d2398799c884a47fc40c029c8e241852, 0x9230f9cbaca32bad2b19cab331d3e6509b8eb0cb, 0x7fc5149f4bb75d5e6778ee9a1b058e6b514352ee, 0x2538325446dd80fc49830eea55d9e662b5acc35c, and 0x852c4f1beb54acb5360dbdba7ebbe9940a698f76. Each returned getMinDelay() = 172800 and assigned sole proposer, executor, and canceller authority to the corresponding chain-local 1-of-3 Safe.

review.evidence: Boundary migration review on 2026-08-16 confirms that all five authored deployment refs resolve only to reviewed native-issuance routes; no production bridge representation or bridge-only control is included in Mint Authority. Pinned chain state was reviewed at Ethereum 25527148, Base 48598894, Rootstock 9049318, Plume 80928370, and Etherlink 48212139. M_TBILL_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE holders were: Ethereum vault 0x99361435420711723af805f08187c9e6bf796683; Base EOA 0x875c06a295c41c27840b9c9dfda7f3d819d8bc6a plus vault 0x8978e327fe7c72fa4eaf4649c23147e279ae1470; Rootstock 3-of-7 Safe 0x5b087db30433bcf5781f385312b1114e8c4819cc, vault 0xf454a52da2157686ef99702c0c19c0e8d66bc03c, and EOAs 0x875c06a295c41c27840b9c9dfda7f3d819d8bc6a and 0x7ef55ff58dc56ef387bb73a3b63abe9fc47359dd; Plume EOA 0x7ef55ff58dc56ef387bb73a3b63abe9fc47359dd plus vault 0xb05f6aa8c2ea9ab8537cf09a9b765a21de249224; Etherlink 2-of-5 Safe 0xbb065d6c7f08e783fd3d2d9593c4e363fee5cdd5, EOA 0x7ef55ff58dc56ef387bb73a3b63abe9fc47359dd, and vault 0xd65bfeb71271a4408ff335e59ecf6c5b21a33a70. Every chain also retained its local 1-of-3 Safe and shared EOA 0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227 as immediate DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders. All current mint-critical transparent proxies resolved through chain-local ProxyAdmins to two-day timelocks controlled by those local Safes. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: Ankura Trust Company has read-only collateral-account access and independently verifies mTBILL collateral eligibility and NAV daily; current reports remain available through the Midas transparency dashboard. FMA approval applies to the prospectus and is not prudential licensing of Midas Software GmbH. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer-controlled direct mint or immediate minter-administration paths are economically unbounded; existing whole-supply periodic reconciliation and independent attestation evidence remain supported.
